sources.title: Is Gravity the Weakest Force?

evidence.text: Could environmental or nonlinear screening hide a gravity-strength scalar interaction from the experiments used in the exclusion? The paper names Vainshtein and Chameleon mechanisms but leaves both their effectiveness here and their quantum-gravity compatibility unresolved.

sources.title: Is Gravity the Weakest Force?

evidence.text: Build the running high-field Higgs potential, differentiate it, and compare chi with (V'')²/M_Pl² while varying measured mass inputs. The paper adds a separate ±0.5 GeV hadronic uncertainty to its top-mass input and reports a 2-sigma experimental-plus-theory band.

sources.title: Is Gravity the Weakest Force?

evidence.text: Expand a background-dependent mass term, identify its linear fluctuation coupling, and compute exchange with a consistently normalized propagator. Here the operation maps the mass dependence of a GWGC state to its coupling to a horizon-light scalar.
